title: Sulfur cubes eat end rods
description: Fix one of sulfur cube's biggest issue: they cannot eat end rods :P
body:
Since the beginning of time, sulfur cubes missed a really vital feature: They couldn't eat end rods.

However, one day, a brave hero (_ayo, that's me!_) decided to put the realm of fear to an end:

**You can now make sulfur cubes eat end rods**

---
